title: Case Study | Cleaner: Automotive Manufacturer Eliminates Salt Build Up and Delivers $194K in Annual Savings
summary: An Ohio automotive manufacturer switched to borate-free QH EXOMAX™ 154, eliminated salt build up in its washers, and saves about $194,000 a year.
body_markdown:
Case Study | Automotive


Cleaner: Automotive Manufacturer Eliminates Salt Build Up and Delivers $194K in Annual Savings


QH EXOMAX™ 154


**~$194,000** total annual savings


**~$180,000** annual savings from part quality


**Eliminated** borate salt build up


## The Challenge


An automotive manufacturer in Ohio was experiencing borate salt build up from its existing cleaner. Deposits accumulated on equipment and washer heating elements, increasing maintenance requirements, contributing to unplanned downtime, and reducing overall system efficiency. In addition, the cleaner exhibited limited biostability, resulting in odor issues and elevated bacterial activity that negatively impacted process stability and fluid performance.


## The Solution


Following an assessment of the application's operating requirements, Quaker Houghton recommended transitioning to QH EXOMAX™ 154, a Ford TOX-approved cleaner engineered for automotive manufacturing environments. Its borate-free formulation eliminated the source of salt deposits, while its biostable technology helped reduce bacterial growth and odor formation. This solution supported improved washer reliability, enhanced fluid performance, and more consistent operational results.


## The Benefits


- Optimized tool life, generating annual savings of approximately $14K
- Enhanced part quality and process consistency, delivering annual savings of approximately $180,000.
- Improved cleaning performance across production operations.
- Elimination of borate salt build up, reducing maintenance requirements and helping prevent heating element failures.
- Improved process stability through biostable technology that minimizes bacterial activity and odor formation.
- Enhanced operational performance through cleaner equipment and reduced downtime.
- Total annual savings of approximately $194,000


## The Product


QH EXOMAX™ 154 is an alkaline liquid spray washer cleaner with automotive OEM approvals. Engineered to provide effective cleaning and free-rinsing performance, it is suitable for both ferrous and non-ferrous materials. The formulation supports application-specific cleaning requirements while helping manufacturers improve process stability, optimize equipment performance, and maintain consistent cleaning results.
